purpose: silver_nyc_weather provides cleaned, typed hourly weather observations for the NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, intended to feed downstream analyses that join weather conditions to flight operations data.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to combine with flight records at the matching airport and hour; expect wind_gust to be null for the large majority of rows and pressure and wind_dir to be null for a meaningful minority, so consumers must handle nulls explicitly rather than assume full coverage; calendar fields (year, month, day, hour) are redundant with time_hour and can be used for partitioning or filtering.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve the high sparsity of wind_gust (null_rate 0.745505) or the moderate sparsity of pressure (null_rate 0.114953) and wind_dir (null_rate 0.016828); no exact duplicate rows were observed (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) but near-duplicate or clock-drift rows were not assessed since no row-hash or timestamp-skew evidence was available in the profile.
